name: @mwaeckerlin/hermes
description: Secure sandboxed NousResearch Hermes agent with SSH-isolated Ubuntu sandbox and Docker-in-Docker support

scripts.deploy: docker compose push hermes-dashboard hermes-gateway hermes-sandbox
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:docs && npm run test:unit && npm run test:python && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:base-path && npm run test:isolation && npm run test:opencode && npm run test:compose
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix files/todo-plugin ci && npm --prefix files/todo-plugin test && npm --prefix files/pairing-plugin ci && npm --prefix files/pairing-plugin test
scripts.test:isolation: docker compose build hermes-gateway hermes-dashboard hermes-sandbox && bash tests/run-isolation.sh
scripts.test:opencode: docker compose build hermes-sandbox && bash tests/opencode-delegation.sh && bash tests/opencode-local.sh
